axis_supply.supply_status: Critical for offensive operations, barely adequate for defensive operations. Primary constraints: (1) Fuel delivery from Tripoli (1,800km over single coastal road), (2) Severe vehicle shortage reduces transport capacity by ~60%, (3) Allied interdiction of Mediterranean supply convoys. Malta-based RAF and Royal Navy attacks sinking 40%+ of Axis supply ships.
axis_supply.notes: Division mobility severely compromised by chronic shortage of trucks (175 on-hand vs 998 authorized = 17.5% strength). Water supply critical in desert - division had 1 motorized water column and 1 filtration column. Fuel situation desperate during El Alamein - often only enough for 2-3 days defensive operations.

allied_supply.supply_status: Good for offensive operations. Short supply lines from Alexandria (250km). Division well-supplied with ammunition and fuel for El Alamein assault, though desert conditions strained water supplies.
